name: Members
overview: Scripture teaches that the church is composed of many members, each with distinct roles and functions, yet united as one body in Christ. Romans 12:4-5 emphasizes the diversity of members and their interconnectedness, highlighting that every believer belongs to one another in the body. Ephesians 4:12 further reveals that these members are equipped and perfected for ministry and the edification of the whole body, underscoring the importance of each member's contribution to the church's spiritual growth and unity.
